mira_route1.say: I've been running diagnostics on {rival}. Do you know how many times it blinked while I watched? Thirty. Evenly spaced. Like a metronome.
I figured the Debugger would work on my Bytekin the same way as yours. So: let's see how well *you* handle yours.
Tactical advantage is just a polite way of saying I did my homework!

win.say: Okay. Okay! You win. This round.
Here. Stability Clamps. Hit a wild Bytekin with one and its STABILITY drops, which makes CONTAIN much easier. I made three.
Briarfield's just past the tall grass. Vale says the Node there is 'acting up'. I want to see why before you do.

oldman_r1.say: No? Hm. You have a familiar face. Everyone does, lately.

oldman_r1_after.say: The grass seems to be growing in the wrong order today. I think. Or I'm the one who's wrong.

then.say: You found it! ...You keep it. I have twelve. They're all lost in different places.

else.say: The crystal's somewhere in Drainage Pipe 01. West side, down the cave path. Watch for pipes. And Mudbytes.
I'm on Route 01 duty. Fixing the signal posts. They keep fixing themselves back.
I dropped a SIGNAL CRYSTAL in Drainage Pipe 01 yesterday. It's a thing that makes Signal-type Bytekin evolve. Sort of.

else.ask: If you find it, you can keep it. I just want to know where it went. Deal?

yes.say: Entrance is on the west side of Route 01, past the hiker. Thanks!

no.say: Okay. The pipe isn't going anywhere. Probably.
